credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded year on year and sits comfortably above the consumer staples sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix in Unilever's branded home and personal care portfolio. This earnings resilience underpins cash generation through input-cost cycles.

Gross and net leverage both declined year on year and remain below the sector median on a like-for-like definition, placing the issuer in the intermediate indicative risk band with meaningful headroom to the next leverage threshold.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor section is largely a cross-reference index rather than substantive narrative, so disclosed business, input-cost and regulatory exposures cannot be assessed in detail here; this is a material evidence gap for a consumer staples issuer with emerging-market revenue concentration.

The current ratio is below one and below the sector median, indicating reliance on refinancing short-dated borrowings and continued market access; a funding-market closure would pressure liquidity despite strong interest coverage.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage exceeds the sector median and EBITDA coverage is similarly comfortable, so operating earnings absorb finance costs with a wide cushion. Coverage slipped marginally year on year, consistent with a modestly higher average cost of borrowings.

Free cash flow covers a substantial share of borrowings and exceeds the sector median on the same measure, while operating cash flow to debt also compares favourably. Cash conversion weakened year on year, so we treat the improvement in leverage as partly working-capital driven.

overall_credit_view.text: We view the credit as solidly investment-grade in character: intermediate indicative financial risk, with gross and net leverage below the sector median and interest coverage above it. Deleveraging year on year supports the profile, though the trajectory is modest rather than dramatic.

Our forward judgement is stable-to-positive, contingent on cash conversion recovering and distributions not absorbing the bulk of free cash flow; dividend and buyback amounts are not disclosed in this bundle, so shareholder-return funding coverage remains unknown and warrants monitoring.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率按年擴大，並穩居消費必需品行業中位數之上，反映聯合利華品牌家居及個人護理組合的定價能力與產品結構。此盈利韌性支撐其於投入成本周期中的現金生成。
按同類可比定義，總槓桿及淨槓桿均按年下降，並維持於行業中位數以下，使發行人處於中間指示性風險區間，距下一槓桿門檻仍有顯著緩衝。

key_risks.text: 風險因素章節主要為交叉引用索引而非實質性敘述，故無法於此詳細評估所披露的業務、投入成本及監管風險敞口；對一家收入集中於新興市場的消費必需品發行人而言，此為重大證據缺口。
流動比率低於一且低於行業中位數，顯示其依賴短期借款再融資及持續市場准入；儘管利息覆蓋強勁，融資市場關閉仍將對流動性構成壓力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋高於行業中位數，EBITDA覆蓋同樣充裕，故經營盈利以寬裕緩衝吸收財務成本。覆蓋率按年略為下滑，與平均借款成本溫和上升一致。
自由現金流覆蓋借款的相當比例，並按同一指標高於行業中位數，而經營現金流對債務比率亦較為有利。現金轉換按年轉弱，故我們認為槓桿改善部分由營運資金驅動。

overall_credit_view.text: 我們認為該信用本質上屬穩健的投資級：中間指示性財務風險，總槓桿及淨槓桿低於行業中位數，利息覆蓋則高於中位數。按年去槓桿支持該狀況，惟軌跡屬溫和而非戲劇性。
我們的前瞻判斷為穩定至正面，取決於現金轉換回升及分派不致吸收大部分自由現金流；本資料包未披露股息及回購金額，故股東回報的資金覆蓋情況仍屬未知，值得監察。
